noticeKeyNotStored: The API key could not be saved in the Keychain, so the agent did not start

updNoNewer: Homebrew has no newer version yet

errTitleNoKey: The network access needs an API key, and none could be read

addModelEmpty: Type a model's name to search Hugging Face, or paste owner/repo:variant

engineInstallStopNote: {engine} is not installed. Homebrew installs it (about {size} of disk space), and the server stops. Requests in progress are cut off

@engineInstallStopNote.description: Confirmation of a switch to an engine that is not installed, while the server runs. {size} is the engine's size on disk, such as "56 MB".

chatOff: The chat opens once the server is running

@chatOff.description: Tooltip of the disabled Open chat button: why it is off.

@memInUse.description: Memory card: caption after the memory in use when no budget is known.

@chat.description: Header button that opens the chat of the running server.

@log.description: Label of the button that opens the engine log (header and error blocks).

@settings.description: Header button that opens the Settings screen.

@themeDark.description: Header button that switches the panel to the dark theme.

@themeLight.description: Header button that switches the panel to the light theme.

@quit.description: Header button that quits the app.

@pillNotInstalled.description: Status pill: the engine is not installed.

@pillInstalling.description: Status text while the engine is being installed.

@pillInstallFailed.description: Status text when the install failed.

@pillUpdating.description: Status pill while the engine updates.

@pillStopped.description: Status pill: the server is not running.

@pillLoading.description: Status pill: the server is loading the model.

@pillReady.description: Status pill: the server is ready.

@pillGenerating.description: Status pill: the server is answering a request.

@pillReleased.description: Status pill: the server runs, the model weights are unloaded from memory.

@pillExternal.description: Status pill: a server started by another app is running.

@pillUnresponsive.description: Status pill: the server is alive but does not answer.

@pillStopping.description: Status pill: the server is shutting down.

@subNoBrew.description: Header subtitle when Homebrew is missing. {engine} is the engine's display name.

@subStopped.description: Header subtitle when the server is not running.

@subLoading.description: Header subtitle while the model loads. {duration} is a formatted duration such as "24 seconds".

@subReady.description: Header subtitle when the server is ready. {duration} is the uptime, such as "2 hours 14 minutes".

@subGenerating.description: Header subtitle while the server answers. {duration} is the uptime.

@subReleased.description: Header subtitle when the weights are unloaded. {duration} is the uptime.

@subError.description: Header subtitle after a failure. {duration} is the time since the server stopped.

@subExternal.description: Header subtitle for a server started by another app. {duration} is its uptime.

@subUnresponsive.description: Header subtitle when the server does not answer. {duration} is the time without a response.

@subStopping.description: Header subtitle while the server shuts down and frees memory.

@subInstalling.description: Header subtitle during the install. {engine} is the engine's name, {version} the version being installed.

@actStartOn.description: Main button after a port conflict: start the server on a free port.

@actCancel.description: Main button while the model loads: cancel the start.

@actRestart.description: Main button after a failure: start the server again.

@actKill.description: Main button for a server started by another app: end its process.

@actForce.description: Button that kills an unresponsive or slow-stopping server.

@actStopping.description: Disabled main button while the server stops.

@actRetry.description: Button that repeats a failed install or update.

loadingText: Loading the model. The server will respond when ready

@loadingText.description: Note under the progress band while the model loads.

errTitlePort: Port {port, number, ::group-off} is in use by another app

@errTitlePort.description: Error title: the server port is taken by another app.

errTitleModel: Model files not found. Turn on “Check for model updates” to download the model

@errTitleModel.description: Error title: the model files are missing and downloads are off.

errTitleMemory: The model ran out of memory: {engine} waited {duration}. Close other apps and start again

@errTitleMemory.description: Error title: the model ran out of memory. {duration} is how long the engine waited.

@errTitleExit.description: Error title: the server process exited. {code} is the exit code.

@errActPort.description: Error button that opens the port setting.

@errActModel.description: Error button that opens the model list.

extNote: This server was not started from the panel. You can stop it only by ending its process. Panel settings do not apply to it

@extNote.description: Note for a server that was not started from the panel.

modelLocked: The model was set when this server started

@modelLocked.description: Tooltip of the model button for a server started by another app.

hangNote: The server has not responded for {duration} and the queue is stuck. It may be hung

@hangNote.description: Warning when the server stops answering. {duration} is the time without a response.

stopLong: Stopping is taking longer than usual

@stopLong.description: Warning when stopping takes longer than usual.

@avail.description: Tooltip of the update chip. {version} is the new version.

updNote: {engine} {version} is ready to install. The server will restart

@updNote.description: Note under the header when an update exists. {engine} is the engine's name, {version} the new version.

updText: Homebrew is installing the new version. The server will then start with the same model

@subUpdating.description: Header subtitle during the update. {engine} is the engine's name, {version} the new version.

@updFailTitle.description: Error title: the update failed. {engine} is the engine's name, {version} the target version.

keepOld: The previous version {version} is still running

@keepOld.description: Note after a failed update. {version} is the version that still runs.

@instProgress.description: Note while the install runs. {engine} is the engine's name.

@instFailTitle.description: Error title: the install failed. {engine} is the engine's name.

@sizeMb.description: A size in decimal megabytes. {value} is the formatted number.

@instTitle.description: Title of the install card. {engine} is the engine's name.

instText: {engine} is installed with Homebrew. It takes about a minute and needs about {size} of disk space

@instText.description: Body of the install card. {size} is a formatted size such as "270 MB".

instNote: Models are downloaded separately on first launch

@brewTitle.description: Title of the card shown when Homebrew is missing.

brewText: {engine} is installed with Homebrew, a package manager for macOS. Install it using the instructions on the website, then come back here

@brewText.description: Body of the Homebrew card. {engine} is the engine's name.

@openBrew.description: Button that opens the Homebrew website. {host} is the host name.

@brewReq.description: Requirements line. {arch} is the CPU architecture, {os} the minimum macOS.

@copyAddr.description: Label of the address chip that copies the server address.

popNote: Models from Hugging Face. A download does not stop the server; switching models restarts it

@popNote.description: Note under the model list: models come from Hugging Face, a download does not stop the server, and switching models restarts the server.

@unload.description: Button that unloads the model from memory.

@load.description: Button that loads the model into memory.

@almost.description: Label shown when memory is almost full.

@idleNote.description: Memory card note. {duration} is the idle time before the model unloads.

@sizeGb.description: A size in decimal gigabytes. {value} is the formatted number.

@usedOf.description: Disk usage. {used} is a number without unit, {total} a formatted size.

@ofTotal.description: Memory budget. {total} is a formatted size.

@liveNote.description: Caption of the live speed of the request in progress, shown instead of the average while a request runs.

@liveTokens.description: How many tokens the request in progress has generated so far. A label and the number, so the words stay still while the number counts up (no plural forms).

@speedTps.description: A speed in tokens per second. {value} is the formatted number.

@trayGb.description: Menu bar value in gigabytes. {value} is a whole number.

@trayTps.description: Menu bar value in tokens per second. {value} is a whole number.

@queue.description: Chip with the number of queued requests.

@firstToken.description: Time to first token. {seconds} is rounded to one decimal place (use format.Seconds).

@promptSpeed.description: Prompt processing speed. {speed} is a formatted speed such as "1,240 tok/s".

chartLabel: {count, plural, one {Last request} other {Last # requests}}, from {min} to {max}

@chartLabel.description: Accessible label of the speed chart. {count} is the number of bars, {min} a number without unit, {max} a formatted speed.

@lastReq.description: Footer when the model is unloaded. {duration} is the time since the last request.

@loadsOnFirst.description: Footer when the model is unloaded: it loads on the next request.

speedEmpty: No requests yet — speed appears after the first answer

@speedEmpty.description: Note in the speed card before the first request has finished. It replaces the chart and the average.

@durSeconds.description: A duration in seconds, as used inside sentences (after "in", "ago", "for").

@durMinutes.description: A duration in minutes, as used inside sentences.

@durHours.description: A duration in hours, as used inside sentences.

@durDays.description: A duration in days, as used inside sentences.

@durJoin.description: Joins two duration parts, such as "2 hours" and "14 minutes".

@durShortSeconds.description: A short duration in seconds for the header subtitle: a number and an abbreviated unit, one line.

@durShortMinutes.description: A short duration in minutes for the header subtitle: a number and an abbreviated unit.

@durShortHours.description: A short duration in hours for the header subtitle: a number and an abbreviated unit.

@durShortDays.description: A short duration in days for the header subtitle: a number and an abbreviated unit.

@hoverReq.description: Chart hover text prefix for a past request.

@hoverCur.description: Chart hover text prefix for the request in progress.

agentNeedsContext: {agent} needs a context of {need} tokens or more, and the model is served with {have}. Raise it in Settings → Model, then restart

@agentNeedsContext.description: Tooltip of an agent chip that is off because the server's context is too small. {agent} is e.g. "Claude"; {need} and {have} are sizes such as "100K" and "33K".

agentStart: Starts the server and the agent

@agentStart.description: Tooltip of agent buttons when the server is stopped or unloaded.

@agentOffError.description: Tooltip of disabled agent buttons after a server error.

@agentOffUnresponsive.description: Tooltip of disabled agent buttons when the server does not answer.

@agentOffStopping.description: Tooltip of disabled agent buttons while the server stops.

cutRequests: {n, plural, one {# request will be interrupted} other {# requests will be interrupted}}

@cutRequests.description: Dialog note: requests in progress that a quit or update interrupts. {n} is their number.

@quitTitle.description: Quit dialog title. The app name is always Lumilo.

@quitBtn.description: Confirm button of the quit dialog.

@quitUpdTitle.description: Quit dialog title while an update runs. {engine} is the engine's name.

@quitUpdNote.description: Quit dialog note while an update runs.

@quitAfter.description: Button: quit after the update finishes.

@updLater.description: Button: update when the server is idle.

killTitle: End the {engine} process of another app?

@killTitle.description: Title of the dialog that ends another app's server process. {engine} is the engine's name.

killNote: The app that started it will lose the server

@access.description: Label of the server access control.

hintLocal: The server listens on {address}. Only apps on this computer can reach it

@hintLocal.description: Hint for the local mode. {address} is host:port.

hintNetwork: Devices on your network reach the server at {address}. It also listens on VPN and other networks of this computer, so a forwarded port or a tunnel works too

@hintNetwork.description: Hint for the network mode. {address} is host:port.

warnNetwork: Any device on your network can use the model, and the internet too if you forward the port. The server accepts no request without the key

@apiKey.description: Label of the API key row.

@copyKey.description: Label of the button that copies the key.

@newKey.description: Label of the button that creates a new key.

keyNote: The key is required while the server is open. Stored in Keychain

@hosts.description: Label of the allowed host names.

@remove.description: Label prefix of the button that removes a host name.

@add.description: Button that adds a host name.

hostsNote: {engine} answers only requests to known names. Add the domain of your tunnel or forwarded port

@hostsNote.description: Note under the allowed host names. {engine} is the engine's name.

@model.description: Title of the Settings model card.

@idleUnload.description: Label of the idle unload setting.

@checkModelUpdates.description: Label of the switch that turns model update checks on.

@app.description: Title of the Settings app card.

@terminal.description: Label of the setting that picks the terminal app in which coding agents open (Terminal, Ghostty or Rex). The label must not repeat a value of the select.

@system.description: Language option that follows the system.

@engineVersion.description: Label of the engine version row. {engine} is the engine's name.

@checkUpdates.description: Button that checks for engine updates.

@checkLatest.description: Settings, under the engine version, after the user checked for updates: the installed version is the newest. {version} is the installed version.

@checkAvail.description: Settings, under the engine version, after the user checked for updates: a newer version exists. {version} is the new version.

@checkFailed.description: Settings, under the engine version: the update check the user asked for failed.

appUpdNote: Lumilo updates itself from its releases on GitHub

@appUpdNote.description: App card: Lumilo updates itself; the note under Lumilo's version.

appUpdOff: This copy can’t update itself: update it with Homebrew

@appUpdOff.description: App card, under Lumilo's version: this copy cannot replace itself (a development build, or a folder the user cannot write to).

@appUpdDownloading.description: App card, under Lumilo's version: the new version downloads. {version} is it; the downloaded and total sizes follow.

appUpdReady: Version {version} is ready: restart to use it

@appUpdReady.description: App card and the Settings button's description: the new version is installed and runs after a restart. {version} is it.

@appUpdFailed.description: App card, under Lumilo's version: the download or install of the new version failed. {version} is it.

@appUpdRestart.description: Button that restarts Lumilo into its new version.

@appUpdAuto.description: Label of the switch that downloads Lumilo's new versions by themselves.

@restartUpdTitle.description: Dialog title: restarting into Lumilo's new version stops the server or downloads.

restartUpdNote: The server and downloads stop and start again after the restart

@restartUpdNote.description: Dialog note: what happens to the server and downloads when Lumilo restarts to update.

restartUpdLater: Restart Lumilo to update when it finishes?

@restartUpdLater.description: Dialog note: Lumilo's new version waits, but the engine is still installing or updating; Lumilo can restart once that ends.

@appUpdRestartLater.description: Dialog button: restart into Lumilo's new version once the engine's install or update ends.

@blink.description: Label of the switch that animates the menu bar icon while the server answers.

@restartStopped.description: Banner text when settings changed and the server is stopped.

restartAgents: Running agents will lose their connection

@restartAgents.description: Second banner line: running agents lose their connection.

restartNote: Changes apply after the server restarts

@restartNote.description: Banner text when settings changed and the server runs.

@restart.description: Banner button that restarts the server.

portBusy: Port {port, number, ::group-off} is in use. {free, number, ::group-off} is free

@portBusy.description: Port field error. {port} is the busy port, {free} a free one.

@portTake.description: Button that takes the free port. {free} is that port.

@settingsIdleAfter.description: Idle option. {duration} is a formatted duration such as "10 minutes".

@pillDownloading.description: Status pill while the server downloads a new model.

@downloading.description: Progress text while the server downloads a model and the engine does not say its size.

@downloadingSize.description: Progress text while the server downloads a model. {size} is a formatted size such as "21.2 GB".

@engine.description: Settings: title of the card that chooses the engine.

@engineNotInstalled.description: Settings, engine list: the engine is not installed (in place of its version).

engineSwitchNote: Switching to {engine} stops the server. Requests in progress are cut off

@engineSwitchNote.description: Settings: asks before a switch to another engine stops the running server. {engine} is the engine's name.

@engineSwitchBtn.description: Settings: button that confirms the switch to another engine.

engineNote: One engine runs at a time. An engine that is not installed is installed with Homebrew

@engineNote.description: Settings: note under the engine list.

@context.description: Settings, Model card: label of the context size select.

@ctxAuto.description: Context size option: the engine chooses (the model's native window when memory holds it).

ctxChipTip: Context: {tokens} tokens. Click to change it in Settings

@ctxChipTip.description: Tooltip of the context chip beside the server address. {tokens} is a number such as "65,536".

ctxChipAutoTip: Context: Auto, the largest that fits in memory or the engine's own. Click to change it in Settings

@ctxChipAutoTip.description: Tooltip of the context chip while the server is stopped and the model's context is Auto.

@ctxOther.description: Context size option that opens a field for another size.

@ctxOtherLabel.description: Label of the field for another context size, typed in K (1024 tokens).

ctxBad: Enter a whole number of K tokens (K = 1024)

@ctxBad.description: Error under the context size field when the text is not a size.

ctxWarn: Past the model’s native context of {size}, answers can get worse at every length

@ctxWarn.description: Warning for a context size past the model's native context. {size} is that context, such as "256K".

@ctxNative.description: Note under the context size select. {size} is the model's native context, such as "256K".

@refreshList.description: Model list: icon button that reads the installed models and engines from disk again, after a change made outside the app.

addModelHint: A model from Hugging Face. The server downloads it when it starts

@addModelHint.description: Note under the field for a model name to download.

@addModelBad.description: Error under the field for a model name when the engine does not accept it.

@addModelLoading.description: Note under the field for a model name while the variants of the chosen repository load.

addModelBlocked: Not available now: the server is busy or was started by another app

@addModelBlocked.description: Tooltip of the disabled Download button under the field for a model name while the server cannot start a download: it is busy, updating, or not ours.

@modelDownloads.description: How often a repository in the suggestions of the field for a model name was downloaded.

@suggestTitle.description: Server card title when the engine has no model yet.

suggestNote: Download a model from Hugging Face. It is ready to run once downloaded

@suggestNote.description: Note above the suggested models to download: the model can be started once downloaded.

@paramsMoe.description: Size of a suggested mixture-of-experts model. {params} is the count in all, {active} the count active per token, such as "36B" and "3B".

needsMemory: Needs about {size} of memory, this Mac has {total}

@needsMemory.description: Warning on a suggested model that does not fit in memory. {size} is what it needs, {total} the computer's memory, such as "77 GB" and "51.5 GB".

@download.description: Button that downloads a suggested model.

@clearField.description: “Add model…” field: the button that clears the typed name.

memTooMuch: Needs about {size} of memory, more than the {total} available

@memTooMuch.description: Warning: a model needs more memory than the engine may use. {size} is what it needs, {total} what the engine may use (about three quarters of the Mac's memory).

visionTip: Loads the vision projector, {size}. Off, the model reads text only

@visionTip.description: Tooltip of the image input switch. {size} is the projector's size.

visionNoJPEG: JPEG images are not read here: TensorFold needs libjpeg-turbo 3.1.4.1, which Homebrew does not offer. PNG and WebP images work

@draftAlways.description: Tooltip of the speculative decoding switch when the engine cannot turn its draft off. {engine} is the engine's name, {name} the draft's repository.

draftMTPTip: Drafts tokens with the model’s own MTP layers

@draftModelTip.description: Tooltip of the speculative decoding switch for a draft model. {name} is its file, {size} its size.

@errTitleModelOnline.description: Error title: the server could not download its model online (bad name, no network).

errTitleNoVision: This model has no image input. Start it for text only

@errTitleNoVision.description: Error title: the engine cannot prepare the model's image input (its repository has no vision projector); it starts for text only.

@errActTextOnly.description: Error button: turns image input off for the model and starts the server again.

errTitleDraft: Draft model {name} is not on this Mac. Download it to start the model

@errTitleDraft.description: Error title: the model's draft model (speculative decoding) is missing from the Hugging Face cache and downloads are off. {name} is the draft's repository.

@errActDraft.description: Error button: downloads the missing draft model at the version the model was installed with.

@textOnly.description: Tag under a model to download: its repository has no vision projector, so it is downloaded and served for text only.

@dlCancel.description: Label and tooltip of the × button of a model being downloaded in the model list.

@dlCancelling.description: Model list: a download being cancelled, until the engine stops.

@dlRemove.description: Button of a failed download in the model list: removes it from the list with its partial files.

@dlTextOnly.description: Button of a download that failed because the model has no image input: downloads it again for text only.

dlFailNoVision: This model has no image input

@dlFailNoVision.description: Model list: why a download failed, the model's image input cannot be prepared.

@dlFailModel.description: Model list: why a download failed, the repository or variant does not exist.

@dlFailed.description: Model list: a download failed for another reason; the engine's line is its tooltip.

@adoptTitle.description: Model list: heading of the models found on disk (the Hugging Face cache) that the engine has not installed yet.

@adopt.description: Model list: button that installs a model found on disk for the engine; it downloads only missing files.

@downloaded.description: Model list: tag of a model whose download just finished.

@dlPreparing.description: Model list: a download that has not fetched a byte yet (the engine checks the model first).

@addModelWait.description: Tooltip of the disabled Download button while the engine updates or is being switched.

@dlQueued.description: Model list: a download waiting for the one before it to finish; one runs at a time.

@dlPaused.description: Model list: a download stopped with its files kept (Lumilo quit, or another engine runs); a size like “6.1 of 17.4 GB” may follow after “ · ”.

@dlResume.description: Button of a paused download: goes on from what it fetched.

@dlPause.description: Button of a running or queued download: stops it and keeps what it fetched, for Resume.

@addModelNothing.description: Under the Add model field: the search on Hugging Face found no repository the engine runs.

@addModelNoVariants.description: Under the Add model field: the repository typed with “:” has no variant (GGUF quantization) the engine can run.

@addModelUnreachable.description: Under the Add model field: the search or the look at a repository failed, as without a network.

@updatesOn.description: Chip in the server card, a toggle: the server checks Hugging Face for model updates on start (the other state is noUpdates).

updatesOffTip: The server starts offline, without checking models for updates. Click to check on start

@updatesOffTip.description: Tooltip of the model-updates chip while off: what off does and what a click does.

updatesOnTip: On start, the server checks Hugging Face for model updates. Click to start offline

@updatesOnTip.description: Tooltip of the model-updates chip while on: what on does and what a click does.

@appliesOnRestart.description: Note under the server card's chips after the model-updates chip changed while the server runs; a Restart button follows.

@rmTitle.description: Title of the dialog that deletes an installed model from the disk.

@rmCounting.description: Note of that dialog while the size of the files to delete is counted.

rmFrees: Frees {size} on the disk. To use the model again, download it again.

@rmFrees.description: Note of that dialog: what deleting frees. {size} is a size, such as "15.7 GB".

rmShared: The files are in the Hugging Face cache, so other apps that use them lose them too.

@rmShared.description: Second note of that dialog, when the files are in the cache that other programs read too.

@rmStops.description: Note of that dialog when the server runs the model.

@rmCountFailed.description: Note of that dialog when the files could not be counted. {line} is the error, in English.

@rmDeleting.description: Status of a model in the model list while its files are deleted.

@rmFailed.description: Title of the notice that a model was not deleted; the reason, in English, shows under it.

rmBusy: Not available while another model is being deleted

@rmBusy.description: Tooltip of the disabled trash button while another model is deleted.

@rmWait.description: Tooltip of the disabled trash button while the engine updates, installs or is being switched.

rmWaitDownload: Not available while a model downloads

@rmWaitDownload.description: Tooltip of the disabled trash button while a download of the engine runs or waits.
